title: 3-beat explainer scene
prompt: A 12-second explainer scene for a password manager, in three beats of ~4s each: (1) a messy pile of sticky notes with passwords appears and jitters anxiously, (2) they get sucked into a shield/vault icon, (3) the shield glows and a single "One key. Every login." headline lands with a check mark. Flat illustration style, friendly colors. Each beat should hand over to the next — no hard cuts.

checklist.text: jitter/anxious motion (wiggle expression or many small keys)
